|  8 | *wHubDelay* | 2 | This field defines the maximum delay in nanoseconds a hub introduces while forwarding packets in either direction. Note that the maximum value a hub is allowed to report in this field is tHubDelay. See Section 10.19.  |
|  10 | *DeviceRemovable* | 2 | Indicates if a port has a removable device attached. This field is reported on byte-granularity. Within a byte, if no port exists for a given location, the bit field representing the port characteristics shall be 0. Bit value definition: 0B - Device is removable. 1B - Device is non-removable. This is a bitmap corresponding to the individual ports on the hub: Bit 0: Reserved for future use Bit 1: Port 1 Bit 2: Port 2 ... Bit n: Port n (implementation-dependent, up to a maximum of 15 ports)  |
